notes.title: Achievements and Trading Card Update!
notes.notes:
你好, Olá, Hallo, Bonjour, Hello!

We are happy to announce Steam Achievements and  Steam Trading Cards, together with profile badges, background images and chat emoticons for you to collect. We wouldn’t have reached this tier without the support of you, our fans.

Thank you so much for playing Shapik: The Moon Quest.
